Hummingbirds feed on nectar from flowers. Nectar is rich in sugars.

Fig. 10.1 shows a hummingbird.

{{figure:figure_10_1.png}}

Fig. 10.1

A study of aerobic respiration in captive hummingbirds was carried out. The hummingbirds were allowed to feed freely and then made to fast for 4 hours. During the fasting period their RQ values were calculated every 40 minutes.

Fig. 10.2 shows the results from this study.

{{figure:figure_10_2.png}}

Fig. 10.2

Describe **and** suggest explanations for the results shown in Fig. 10.2.
